fields.PRODUCT NAME: Rajasthani Marble Decorative Plate with Peacock Painting
fields.DESCRIPTION: Celebrate the grandeur of Rajasthan with this hand-painted marble decorative plate, featuring a majestic royal elephant motif adorned with intricate patterns and traditional embellishments. The elephant, a timeless symbol of strength, royalty, and good fortune, is beautifully detailed with meenakari-style artistry and highlighted with sparkling stones for a regal touch. Handcrafted by skilled artisans on premium white marble, this plate showcases vibrant colors, golden accents, and ornate borders that reflect the opulence of Rajasthani heritage. It comes with a sturdy wooden stand, making it a stunning addition to your home décor, office space, or as an elegant gift for loved ones.
